titulo: Judge blocks X rival from using Twitter name, but allows ‘Tweet’ for now
resumo_original: A federal judge temporarily barred an X rival from using the Twitter name, but found that X was likely to have abandoned the “Tweet” trademark and bird logo. The startup has since relaunched as Tweet.app.
